title: Soft Glowing Phone Wallpaper
tests: Tests delivery of a genuinely animated seamless portrait wallpaper with a clock-safe composition, not a landscape clip padded into a phone frame.

faults.what: The supplied frames appear slightly wider than the requested 9:16 portrait ratio.

judge.summary: The wallpaper shows attractive blue and purple glowing ribbons beneath ample dark clock space, though the displayed proportions are slightly wider than requested and seamless looping and silence cannot be verified.

must_haves.item: The deliverable is an 8-second portrait 9:16 video, with artwork filling the frame rather than a landscape image surrounded by bars.
must_haves.why: The clip is identified as eight seconds and the portrait artwork fills the frame without bars, but the supplied frames appear approximately 3:5 rather than 9:16.

must_haves.item: Soft blue and purple glowing ribbons visibly move slowly against a dark background.
must_haves.why: The sampled frames show soft blue and purple luminous ribbons changing their flowing curves over time against black.

must_haves.item: The top third stays mostly dark and uncluttered throughout, with the brightest ribbons concentrated lower down.
must_haves.why: All four samples leave the top third dark and empty, with the ribbons confined to the lower portion.

must_haves.item: Repeated playback has no visible jump, flash or abrupt reset at the loop boundary.
must_haves.why: The one- and seven-second frames look similar, but the actual end-to-start transition is not shown.

must_haves.item: There are no words, clock graphics or other interface elements baked into the video.
must_haves.why: No text, clock graphics, or interface elements are visible in any supplied frame.

must_haves.item: The video has no audible sound.
must_haves.why: Still frames provide no evidence about the audio.
